description: Blank ENE-01/02/03 input template. Copy and set case_id; populate only sourced machine data or explicitly labelled synthetic fixtures. No default machine parameters are provided.

electrical.note: ENE-01..03 require force_constant_N_per_A exactly equal to back_emf_V_per_m_s (reciprocal SI convention).

controller_and_loads.note: Runner uses a constant feedforward current command. ENE-01/02 require zero external force; ENE-03 includes signed external generalized power.

metrics.note: Energy scale/floor and closure threshold must be finite, positive, predeclared and unchanged across the four primary levels (threshold may be null for report-only). The residual noise floor is a separate conservative pre-run bound for the complete residual arithmetic path; document floating-point format, operation/accumulation bounds, quadrature and execution environment in its method/source. Do not infer it from this run, the energy normalization floor, or machine_epsilon multiplied by an energy scale alone. State comparison scales must be finite, positive, sourced engineering characteristic magnitudes (SI units as named) and unchanged across all five trajectory levels; they only nondimensionalize each component and are not tolerances, state bounds, or an aggregate score. Residual empirical order is emitted only when all five paths are smooth, residuals are above the sourced noise floor, signs agree and absolute residuals strictly decrease; it does not affect PASS. Config schema v3; manifest schema v5. Null energy threshold yields COMPLETED_REPORT_ONLY.
